ops.body: Round-4 refuter on 002c5613: NOT clean — 4 HIGH fail-opens in unapplied edges, all reproduced; the core validate-early-abort-loud strategy held everywhere applied (spawn boundary sound, early validators catch the round-3 repros, M3 wiring correct with malformed exclusion, PreflightFailure single identity, full prior held-set intact, updated timeout tests genuine). Findings → A3.6 (round 5): R1 recovery-log read/decode failures bypass accounting (UnicodeDecodeError → candidate crash at $0; OSError → zero-cost re-billable infra retry; wall-cancel → raw exception skips the marker) — normalize at the recovery boundary. R2 validate_driver_cost(0, 10**1000)/huge envelope raise OverflowError (math.isfinite raises on int→float overflow) escaping as candidate crash — convert safely, abort on overflow. R3 ENOSPC mid-append leaves a partial JSONL line → the restart latch silently vanishes after space frees — latch becomes an ATOMIC per-run file (tmp+fsync+os.replace, startup checks existence, operator deletes to reconcile); sidecar breadcrumb stays best-effort for M3 reporting. R4 M2 preflight fail-opens: wrapper commands version `python` instead of claude (passes even with a nonexistent wrapper path); unanchored regex accepts Node/runtime versions from arbitrary output; prerelease 1.0.22-beta.3 == stable floor — fix: version the ACTUAL claude binary, anchor to the CLI's real output shape, any parse failure/prerelease/exec error = PreflightFailure (fail closed). R5 LOW: literal repeated-restart re-bill loop test. Loop trajectory: each round's held set grows and findings narrow to progressively more exotic inputs — round 5 gates the release.
